_comment: Achievements (V): checked by the game, recorded on-chain by SYSTEM (contracts/src/Achievements.sol, ADR 0020). Points feed the achievements leaderboard. Tiers: basique, avancé, difficile, légendaire. Kinds: poc (whole POC held: The Seed Top Contributor), clears (levels cleared), clear_stage (one level, or any of a list), clear_all (all of a list), summon_stars (best summon), account_level, social_level, guild_level, summons, monster_stars, awakened, world_boss_attacks, world_boss_kill, poll_votes, guild, friends, runes. The first player to clear a level also gets 'first-clear:<level>'. PLACEHOLDER list.
